name: Realm of Lust
source:
Realm of Lust is a visual novel in which we embody a young magician in a kingdom where this art is forbidden by royal decree.

We will enter a fantasy world full of waifus in which our actions will decide the future of the empire.
translation:
《欲望之国》是一部视觉小说，我们在其中扮演一位年轻的魔术师，生活在一个被皇家法令禁止的王国中。

我们将进入一个充满流浪汉的奇幻世界，我们的行动将决定帝国的未来。
